brand_note: Spelling follows the supplied logo (image 1). The content document and images 2/4 spell it TESSERACT; change 'brand' here to switch everywhere.
description: TESERACT Creative Studios designs and builds interactive, tailor-made websites and digital experiences for businesses that want to be different.
site_url_note: LAUNCH SWITCH (owner's SEO request, 18 Oct): your own https domain, e.g. "https://www.your-domain.com". It turns on canonical URLs, og:url and absolute share images, directory links, structured-data URLs, breadcrumbs, sitemap.xml and the robots.txt Sitemap line - everything absolute is built from this one value. Set it together with indexable: true (build.py refuses indexable without it). Steps: LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md 'Launch steps'; docs/SEO.md.
timezone_note: Optional IANA zone (e.g. "Europe/London"). When set, the footer clock shows studio time; empty = the visitor's local time.
indexable_note: Kept out of search engines (noindex + robots Disallow) until rights to the portfolio imagery carried over from the ZIP are confirmed. Set to true to allow indexing.
area_served_note: Where the studio works, for the JSON-LD areaServed (owner, 18 Oct: remote, across India and worldwide - no city, no street address, no phone). A country name becomes a schema.org Country; 'Worldwide' stays text.
alternate_names_note: Other names of the studio for the JSON-LD alternateName (Organization + WebSite). You may add "TESSERACT Creative Studios" (the content document's double-S spelling) once you approve it; no case-only variants ("Teseract Creative Studios") - search engines ignore case.
org_profiles_note: The studio's OWN company profiles (LinkedIn company page, studio Instagram, Behance...) under the exact name "TESERACT Creative Studios". While empty, the Organization's sameAs uses the socials above (your personal profiles) as a stop-gap; once filled, only these are used for the company.

chat.enabled_note: Owner, 21 Oct: the 'Ask TESERACT' chat on every page (launcher bottom right). false removes the launcher, chat files and knowledge base from the build.
chat.booking_url_note: Optional https booking page (Calendly / Cal.com / Google appointments). Empty: 'Book a call' opens the contact form with the chat brief filled in. Opened only on the visitor's tap, in a new tab.

pricing.base_currency_note: Prices are set in Indian rupees; other currencies are converted from these with the rates below.
pricing.website_from_note: Owner, 21 Oct: a standard website (a landing page / one-page site counts as a website - owner to confirm) STARTS FROM INR 35,000; pages, features and interactions, content and copy, design detail and integrations change it. The only website price the chat may show, always after 'the final price depends on scope'.
pricing.ecommerce_from_note: Owner, 21 Oct: an e-commerce website STARTS FROM INR 50,000; products, categories, payments and checkout, shipping and features change it. The only e-commerce price the chat may show.
pricing.rates_note: INR per 1 unit. APPROXIMATE static rates proposed 21 Oct for the owner to confirm; nothing is looked up live. Shown as 'about ...', rounded to round_to, with the rupee price alongside.
pricing.rates_date_note: When the rates were set; the chat says 'approximate rate (October 2026)'. check.py warns 90 days after it.
pricing.rates_confirmed_note: Set true once the owner has checked the rates. False = check.py warning now, error in a launch build (indexable or site_url set).
pricing.round_to_note: Converted prices are rounded half-up to this step (35,000 / 115 = 304.3 -> about £300).
